hypothesis: MAIN's pre-cutoff market-offset residual may add executable value only during a coherent causal directional impulse; all other modes should abstain or require a different uncertainty model.
selection_disclosure: The eligible scenario family was selected after a forward calibration diagnostic showed residual Brier improvement in LAG_EDGE, MOMENTUM_BREAKOUT, VOLATILITY_EXPANSION and MOMENTUM_FADE. The clean executable replay remained negative in every scenario. No historical row counts as evidence for either fresh arm.

matched_design.control: fresh unchanged source instance with a new identity
matched_design.challenger: consume the identical first source intent, retain only DIRECTIONAL_IMPULSE when the frozen residual agrees with the source side and clears the executable ask after doubled taker fees plus one token tick
matched_design.filtered_first_intent_rule: A rejected first source intent consumes the market for both source instances; the challenger cannot search later quotes for a favorable mode.

mode_rules.VOLATILITY_TRANSITION: ABSTAIN; a separate multi-sigma envelope such as H61 is required

evaluation.multiple_testing: Holm correction across every MAIN variant, inspected scenario and price band
evaluation.capacity: at most $10 and 20% of displayed touch under a shared $500 bankroll
evaluation.promotion: No live path. A mechanical pass only permits review for a separate authenticated $1-$2 canary.
evaluation.null_outcome: No orders, negative PnL or approximately zero incremental edge are valid outcomes and do not permit threshold changes.
